Examples

speedball — whole-pitch prediction with Kit

1 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

Compare this game with slopball to choose a simulation policy. Slopball hands the ball's physics simulation to the last toucher using play.Puppet. Speedball keeps one authority and lets each peer predict the ball locally. Kit's simulation lane schedules fixed ticks and retains history for correction:

Odin
@(gd_tick = "contested")
ball_tick :: proc(self: ^Ball) -> (scored: u8) { ... }

The contested tag enables local prediction of the shared ball, so local dribbles and kicks can respond before the server result arrives. The integration test drives a ball to goal through 240 ms RTT using local touches. The server settles gameplay: when accepted state disagrees with prediction, the client applies the correction and replays its remaining predicted ticks. Display smoothing eases the resulting position change. Each peer pays the CPU cost of replay and may show a speculative touch that is later corrected.

Goal detection and the kickoff freeze run in the ball's predicted tick. A peer can therefore reset the ball locally when its simulation detects a goal. The authority accepts the score through ball_tick_then on the delta lane. The world pass computes contact and kicks for the kicker⟷ball pairs whose inputs are available to that peer.

Speedball also predicts the players (echo_inputs). The kickers are contested, and batches echo each player's held input so every peer simulates the whole pitch on one predicted timeline. Remote contacts therefore use predicted avatars as well as a predicted ball. Corrections can affect any of them. The lane also supports predicting the ball while watching delayed authority poses for remote players, with a presentation claim selecting the ball's displayed pose; see docs/kit/sim.md's contested section for the tradeoff.

Shell
bash build/build_scripts.sh examples/speedball
$GODOT --path examples/speedball                  # host, join from a second window
SPB_LATENCY=120 $GODOT --path examples/speedball  # observe local response at 240ms RTT

bash examples/speedball/run.sh          # solo gate (SPEEDBALL_SINGLE_OK)
bash examples/speedball/native_run.sh   # contested-ball integration test (three peers)

WASD move · Space kick (aim with your movement) · Tab scores · Enter chat. Env: SPB_ROLE (host/join/single/serve) · SPB_PORT · SPB_NAME · SPB_TOKEN · SPB_LATENCY · SPB_BOT (striker/idle) · SPB_GOALS.
